seen.body: ledger_aliases.scan calls ledger_layout.stamp (root scandir + one stat per shard) on every aliases() call; _homes()/load_mirrors/baseline lookups call aliases() once per item, so a whole-ledger command does items x shards stats (check and sync --all: 42 stamps for 40 items). Flat layout paid one stat. Fix: do not re-stamp on every call.
seen.title: Schema 8 regression: every per-item alias lookup re-stats all ~1200 shards, so check/sync/pr commands take tens of minutes on 25k items
